op="TPR-EXT26-REPAIR-SOURCE-INSPECT-20261021-001"
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
m._guard(head)
created=datetime.now(timezone.utc); deadline=time.monotonic()+120
source_name="TPR-EXT26-MIA-SOURCE-BASELINE-20261021-001.read2.sources.json"
descriptor={"name":source_name,"bytes":268709,"sha256":"f071f76317aa3f6abf1cfb65fec197ec9970a59b25b6959079cdcf17dba708b3"}
public_sources=m._sources(head)
bundle=public_sources[m.BUNDLE]
expected=json.loads(bundle)["candidates"]
expected=next(row["files"] for row in expected if row["candidate_id"]==m.CANDIDATE).copy()
expected["main.py"]=design.build_main(bundle)["main_py"]
ctx=Path("research/target_price_revisions_qc/extended_refusal_witness_context_successor.py").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(ctx).hexdigest()=="1b057f254fba91eee98862bbb63b2141cea63962905c458459d7a47531215a0f"
expected["extended_refusal_witness_context_successor.py"]=ctx.decode()
pins={name:(size,sha) for name,size,sha in capture.SOURCES}
HEADER="# region imports\nfrom AlgorithmImports import *\n# endregion\n"
plan={"schema":"tpr-current-repair-source-inspection-access-v1","operation_id":op,"git_head":head,"owner_instruction_sha256":"4cbdbec4c54b5db78455516442f96c25d636af6e54a214209cef5419e301b9aa","created_utc":created.isoformat(),"expires_utc":(created+timedelta(minutes=15)).isoformat(),"private_inputs":[descriptor],"max_private_bytes":268709,"max_seconds":120,"max_public_bytes":32768,"source_hashes":{name:m._sha(raw) for name,raw in public_sources.items()},"raw_source_stdout":False,"source_executed":False,"network":False,"accepted":False}
def check():
    m._guard(head)
    assert datetime.now(timezone.utc)<created+timedelta(minutes=15) and time.monotonic()<deadline
directory=m.files._directory(m.PRIVATE_ROOT,private=True);lock=None
result={"operation_id":op,"status":"FAILED_OR_UNCERTAIN","source_executed":False,"network":False,"accepted_metrics":None,"strategy_accepted":False,"files":None,"private_read_attempts":0,"private_bytes":0}
try:
    check();m._publish(directory,op+".claim.spent.json",m.e.canonical(plan))
    lock=os.open("controller.lock",os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600,dir_fd=directory)
    try:
        info=os.fstat(lock);assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid==os.getuid() and info.st_nlink==1 and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)==0o600
        check();m._publish(directory,op+".access.json",m.e.canonical(plan))
        result["private_read_attempts"]=1
        check();raw=m.files._read(directory,source_name,expected_size=descriptor["bytes"],expected_sha256=descriptor["sha256"],remaining=268709,private=True)
        result["private_bytes"]=len(raw)
        value=json.loads(raw)
        assert value["project_id"]==37650980 and value["operation_id"]=="TPR-EXT26-MIA-SOURCE-BASELINE-20261021-001" and value["request_index"]==2
        sources=value["files"];assert set(sources)==set(pins)
        rows=[]
        for name,text in sorted(sources.items()):
            check();encoded=text.encode()
            row={"name":name,"bytes":len(encoded),"sha256":m._sha(encoded),"registered_bytes_and_hash_equal":(len(encoded),m._sha(encoded))==pins[name],"syntax":"not_python","header_occurrences":text.count(HEADER)}
            if name.endswith(".py"):
                try: tree=ast.parse(text);compile(text,name,"exec");row["syntax"]="passes_in_memory"
                except SyntaxError as err: row.update(syntax="SyntaxError",syntax_line=err.lineno);tree=None
                row["public_original_available"]=name in expected
                if name in expected:
                    before=expected[name];oldtree=ast.parse(before)
                    variants=[text]
                    if text.count(HEADER)==1:
                        pos=text.index(HEADER);without=text[:pos]+text[pos+len(HEADER):];variants.append(without)
                        if pos<len(without) and without[pos:pos+1]=="\n":variants.append(without[:pos]+without[pos+1:])
                        if pos>0 and without[pos-1:pos]=="\n":variants.append(without[:pos-1]+without[pos:])
                    row["exact_inverse_by_header_and_single_adjacent_newline"]=before in variants
                    if tree is not None:
                        reduced=ast.Module(body=[node for node in tree.body if not(isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom) and node.module=="AlgorithmImports")],type_ignores=[])
                        row["ast_equal_ignoring_only_vendor_import"]=ast.dump(reduced,include_attributes=False)==ast.dump(oldtree,include_attributes=False)
                        def functions(t):
                            return {((parent.name+".") if isinstance(parent,ast.ClassDef) else "")+node.name:node for parent in [t,*[n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef)]] for node in parent.body if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
                        oldfun,newfun=functions(oldtree),functions(tree)
                        changes=[]
                        for func in sorted(set(oldfun)|set(newfun)):
                            a,b=oldfun.get(func),newfun.get(func)
                            if ast.dump(a,include_attributes=False) if a is not None else None:
                                pass
                            if (None if a is None else ast.dump(a,include_attributes=False))!=(None if b is None else ast.dump(b,include_attributes=False)):
                                entry={"known_public_function":func if func in oldfun else None,"new_function_name_sha256":None if func in oldfun else m._sha(func.encode()),"removed":b is None,"before_line":None if a is None else a.lineno,"after_line":None if b is None else b.lineno}
                                entry["before_node_counts"]=None if a is None else dict(collections.Counter(type(n).__name__ for n in ast.walk(a)))
                                entry["after_node_counts"]=None if b is None else dict(collections.Counter(type(n).__name__ for n in ast.walk(b)))
                                changes.append(entry)
                        row["changed_function_nodes"]=changes
                else:
                    row["exact_inverse_to_registered_hash_by_header_removal"]=any((len(candidate.encode()),m._sha(candidate.encode()))==pins[name] for candidate in ([text]+([text.replace(HEADER,"",1),text.replace(HEADER+"\n","",1)] if text.count(HEADER)==1 else [])))
            rows.append(row)
        result.update(status="COMPLETED_SOURCE_CLASSIFICATION",files=rows)
    except (Exception,KeyboardInterrupt) as err:
        result["refusal_type"]=type(err).__name__
    result["ended_utc"]=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    output=m.e.canonical(result)
    if len(output)>32768:
        result["files"]=None;result["status"]="FAILED_OR_UNCERTAIN";result["public_size_refused"]=True;output=m.e.canonical(result)
    check();desc=m._publish(directory,op+".result.json",output)
    print(m.e.canonical({"result":result,"descriptor":desc}).decode())
finally:
    if lock is not None:
        try:
            owned=os.fstat(lock);named=os.stat("controller.lock",dir_fd=directory,follow_symlinks=False)
            if (owned.st_dev,owned.st_ino)==(named.st_dev,named.st_ino):os.unlink("controller.lock",dir_fd=directory)
        except FileNotFoundError:pass
        finally:os.close(lock)
    os.close(directory)
